name: Building AI for Insurance Fraud Detection and SIU Investigations
description: Evaluate fraud referrals, evidence and AI-assisted investigations through twenty lessons and a cumulative fictional US insurer case. Build a capacity-aware queue, audit entity and media signals, preserve claimant safeguards, and reconcile validation and antifraud-plan records.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Building AI for Insurance Fraud Detection and SIU Investigations

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 20 lessons in 6 modules, play each of the course's 7 Decision Labs to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
